findings.text: CONTRACT_DOCUMENT_FIELDS names summary, decisions and gates, but only decisions is guarded: trimming the tuple to ("decisions",) leaves all four tests green, so a regression that stops a summary or gate edit from holding a node passes the suite.

The three fail-closed branches of _document_change_is_contract (no candidate review, no review run id, missing or unreadable snapshot) are untested, so flipping any of them to return False would let an unseen document change through with every test still green.

_document_change_is_contract re-implements the stored-review snapshot lookup that plan_review._snapshot_evidence already owns; it duplicates the run-id, review_report_directory and _REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_NAME resolution rather than extending that owner.
